departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Departments unite the teachers of one discipline. A lesson can be linked to one or several departments, and the head of each of them sees and edits all such lessons, even without teaching them.
departments.confirmDelete: Delete the department “{{name}}”? Its teachers stay in the system but are left without a department.

form.createDescription: Create a department to unite the teachers of one discipline. Once it is saved, open it again to add teachers and choose the head.
form.editDescription: Rename the department, choose its head and manage its teachers. Only a teacher of this department can become its head, and the head edits every lesson linked to the department.
form.head: Head of the department
form.noTeachers: No teachers in this department yet

teachersModal.title: Department teachers
teachersModal.description: {{name}}. Add teachers from the list on the right or remove them from the department. A teacher belongs to one department only, so adding a teacher from another department moves them here. Nothing changes until you save.
teachersModal.empty: No teachers yet. Add them from the list.
teachersModal.allAdded: All teachers are already in the department
teachersModal.movesHint: Will be moved to this department on save
teachersModal.movedNote_one: {{count}} teacher will leave their current department. A head of another department loses that role.
teachersModal.movedNote_other: {{count}} teachers will leave their current departments. A head of another department loses that role.
teachersModal.removedHead: {{name}} will no longer be the head of this department.

studentGroups.title: Student groups
studentGroups.description: Academic groups of students. Every student belongs to one group, and lessons are scheduled for one or several groups, so students see exactly the lessons of their group. Tags help to tell groups apart by form of study or speciality.
studentGroups.confirmDelete: Delete the group “{{name}}”? It will be removed from all its lessons. A group that still has students cannot be deleted.

form.createDescription: Add an academic group. Students join it in their user profile, and teachers pick it when scheduling lessons.
form.editDescription: Changes are shown right away in every lesson of the group and in its students' profiles.
form.noTags: No tags yet: create them in the “Group tags” tab

groupTags.title: Group tags
groupTags.description: Labels for student groups, such as the form of study or the speciality. A group can have several tags, and lessons can be filtered by them to find, for example, all lessons of full-time students.
groupTags.confirmDelete: Delete the tag “{{name}}”? It will be removed from all student groups.

form.createDescription: Create a label for student groups, such as a form of study or a speciality. Then assign it to groups in their settings.
form.editDescription: The new name is shown on every group with this tag and in the lesson filters.

semesters.title: Semesters
semesters.description: Study periods of the academic year. A lesson can be linked to a semester, which splits the schedule into periods and lets you filter lessons by them.
semesters.confirmDelete: Delete the semester “{{name}}”? A semester that already has lessons cannot be deleted.

form.createDescription: Set the name and the dates of the study period. Teachers can then link their lessons to it.
form.editDescription: Rename the semester or adjust its dates. Lessons already linked to it stay linked.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Roles are sets of permissions given to users. The priority builds the hierarchy: you manage only roles and users ranked below your own highest role, and only with the permissions you hold yourself.
roles.confirmDelete: Delete the role “{{name}}”? Users with this role will lose its permissions.
roles.locked: This role ranks at or above yours, or has permissions you lack

form.createDescription: Bundle permissions into a role and assign it to users. The priority must be lower than your own, and you can grant only the permissions you have.
form.editDescription: Changes apply at once to every user with this role. You can grant only the permissions you have.
